display.purpose: Intervention titles and onboarding headings. The dominant voice on each screen.

body.purpose: Intervention instructions and onboarding copy. Max line length 65ch.

label.purpose: Form labels, button text, search placeholder.

caption.purpose: Intervention type badge only. The single uppercase context in the system.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Pop-in completion, draw-check. Most emphatic entrance.

components.name: Primary CTA Button
components.description: Full-width action button pinned to the bottom of each screen. One visible at a time.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 16px 20px; background: #292524; color: #faf8f5; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out, transform 0.1s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #44403c; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #78716c; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #f5f5f4; color: #a8a29e; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Feeling Tile (unselected)
components.description: Grid cell in the feeling picker. 2-column grid, bordered variant.
components.css: .ds-feeling-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 20px 8px; background: #ffffff; color: #57534e; border: 1px solid #e7e5e4; border-radius: 1rem; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: capitalize; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease-out, transform 0.1s ease-out; } .ds-feeling-tile:hover { background: #f5f5f4; } .ds-feeling-tile:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-feeling-tile__emoji { font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-feeling-tile__label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Feeling Tile (selected)
components.description: Selected state of the feeling tile. Matches primary CTA fill.
components.css: .ds-feeling-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 20px 8px; border-radius: 1rem; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: capitalize; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease-out, transform 0.1s ease-out; border: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-feeling-tile--selected { background: #292524; color: #faf8f5; } .ds-feeling-tile:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-feeling-tile__emoji { font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-feeling-tile__label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Choice Button (feedback/intensity)
components.description: Row-based discrete selector used for feedback (Worked / A little / Didn't help) and intensity levels. Muted fill variant.
components.css: .ds-choice-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-choice-btn { flex: 1; padding: 16px 8px; background: #ffffff; color: #57534e; border: 1px solid #e7e5e4; border-radius: 0.75rem; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease-out, transform 0.1s ease-out; } .ds-choice-btn:hover { background: #f5f5f4; } .ds-choice-btn--selected { background: #292524; color: #faf8f5; border-color: transparent; } .ds-choice-btn:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-choice-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #78716c; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 6px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Feeling filter input at the top of the feeling picker.
components.css: .ds-input-search { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 10px 16px; background: #ffffff; color: #57534e; border: 1px solid #e7e5e4; border-radius: 0.75rem; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: #a8a29e; } .ds-input-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #78716c; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 6px; }

components.name: Timer (start state)
components.description: Start button for the breathing/grounding timer. Pill shape, muted fill.
components.html: <button class="ds-timer-start"><svg class="ds-timer-start__icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M14.752 11.168l-3.197-2.132A1 1 0 0010 9.87v4.263a1 1 0 001.555.832l3.197-2.132a1 1 0 000-1.664z"/></svg>Start timer · 20s</button>
components.css: .ds-timer-start { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; background: #f5f5f4; color: #57534e; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease-out; } .ds-timer-start:hover { background: #e7e5e4; } .ds-timer-start__icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Progress Dots
components.description: Onboarding step indicator. Active pill widens; inactive pills are small.
components.css: .ds-progress-dots { display: flex; gap: 6px; justify-content: center; align-items: center; } .ds-progress-dot { display: block; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #e7e5e4; width: 6px; transition: width 0.15s ease-out, background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-progress-dot--active { width: 24px; background: #78716c; }

narrative.overview:
State Shift does not try to make you feel better with words. It hands you one concrete thing to do, waits calmly, and steps back. The design follows the same principle: nothing performs. Type carries the weight; spacing communicates calm; surfaces sit quietly until touched.

The aesthetic is warm editorial — closer to a quality independent magazine than a wellness product. The background is never pure white: it carries a trace of warmth that makes reading feel less clinical. The type stack is deliberate: Lora for the moments that need presence (titles, CTAs), DM Sans for everything that needs to step back (body, labels). The whole system works at the pace of breath, not notification.

This system explicitly rejects: pastel wellness gradients, dark mode with glowing accents, rounded bubbly playfulness, clinical or medical UI, and the full AI slop palette — cyan, purple-to-blue gradients, glassmorphism.
keyCharacteristics: Typography-first: Lora headings carry authority; DM Sans body disappears into readability
One primary action at a time, always full-width, always at the bottom
Tonal elevation over shadows: white surfaces lift naturally against the cream field
Warm stone neutrals throughout; emerald appears only at the single completion moment
Motion is functional, not decorative: entrance fades, contextual slides, one celebrate-worthy pop

rules.name: The Charred Bark Rule
rules.body: Charred Bark appears on at most one CTA and one set of selected states per screen. It is the only value that approaches true dark. Do not introduce a second dark color or a competing accent.

rules.name: The No-White-Background Rule
rules.body: The page background is #faf8f5, not #ffffff. Lifted White (#ffffff) is a surface color reserved for interactive components. Never use it as a page background.

rules.name: The Serif Gate Rule
rules.body: Lora is used only for content headings (h1, h2) and never for button text, labels, or body copy. DM Sans handles all UI chrome.

rules.name: The Uppercase Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Uppercase appears in exactly one context: the intervention type caption. Do not introduce uppercase in buttons, nav, labels, or headings.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No surface casts a shadow at rest. Use tonal contrast (Lifted White on Warm Cream) if separation is needed.

rules.name: The One-Layer Rule
rules.body: There is one level of surface lift: Warm Cream (ground) and Lifted White (surface). Do not nest Lifted White on Lifted White.

dos: Do use Warm Cream (#faf8f5) as the page background. Never pure white for the root surface.
Do keep one full-width primary CTA pinned to the bottom of each screen.
Do use Lora exclusively for h1/h2 content headings. DM Sans for all UI chrome.
Do use the uppercase caption style only for the intervention type label.
Do communicate selection state using the Charred Bark fill.
Do use expo easing (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) for all entrance animations.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: all entrance animations must no-op.
Do keep focus rings: 2px solid #78716c, 3px offset, 6px radius.
donts: Don't use pastel gradient wellness aesthetics (Calm, Headspace palette).
Don't use dark mode or dark surfaces with glowing or neon accents.
Don't use rounded-bubbly playfulness: no bouncing, no elastic easing.
Don't use clinical or medical UI patterns.
Don't use the AI slop palette: no cyan, no purple-to-blue gradients, no glassmorphism.
Don't use box-shadows for depth or card lift.
Don't introduce a second dark color or competing accent alongside Charred Bark.
Don't nest Lifted White surfaces on Lifted White.
Don't use uppercase for anything other than the intervention type caption.
Don't use border-left greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
